# SprintCo

Website: https://www.sprint-co.com
Company: SprintCo
Legal Entity: B2B Designers Pvt. Ltd.

Description:
SprintCo is a restaurant, cafe, bar, and QSR design-build company specialising in concept design, branding, rollout, expansion, MEP planning, and Flatpack modular construction solutions.

Primary Expertise:
- Restaurant Design
- Cafe Design
- Bar Design
- QSR Design
- Restaurant Branding
- Brand Identity Strategy
- MEP Design
- FlatPack Build Solutions
- Restaurant Expansion
- F&B Consulting

Founders:
- Sona Mantri (Founder & CEO)
- Ajay Gupta (Co-Founder)

Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
